planItem: 77.44.7.A — responsive Flex/Grid container and item Inspector contexts across all shared layout types
finding: The shared 18-type layout contract exposed contextual Flex/Grid fields, but no one browser lifecycle matrix exercised each container and child context through responsive Save and separate Publish.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-layout-context-lifecycle.test.js. The test creates every shared layout type, alternates desktop Flex/Grid and uses the opposite mobile mode, then exercises typed container and child Inspector controls through Canvas, draft persistence, publication and inheritance reset.
coverage: All 18 shared layout container types; real Inspector responsive.set command and Page Model key contract; context-specific Flex/Grid fields; Canvas computed styles; draft Save and Editor reload; Save leaves public output unchanged; separate desktop and mobile Publish; mobile Save/Publish preserves desktop values; all mobile container and item overrides are reset to inherited values; Undo/Redo; reset Save leaves published mobile state unchanged; separate reset Publish restores inherited desktop layout.

harnessNotes: Grid fr track computed pixel widths depend on the Canvas and public viewport widths, so parity compares computed track counts and separately asserts the exact saved Page Model template values.
Reset buttons are selected by their declared Page Model key because the shared Inspector group contains multiple reset actions.
Responsive display reset is performed after resetting child fields because changing a parent layout context changes which child controls are visible.
